# Morocco OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **12 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Morocco ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Morocco national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Morocco public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Morocco in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 8,050,000 |
| Lines / route length | 42 / 860 km |
| Fleet | 1,421 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $7.17 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $5.48 B (76%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 146.7 MW / 759.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $11.22 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
